environment.description: Staging Rails 7.1 API server on ECS Fargate behind same ALB configuration. LaunchDarkly project 'platform-staging' has both flags configured with targeting rules: `legacy_marshal_import` returns FALSE for all contexts where `environment` attribute is not in the explicit allowlist (allowlist is empty after JIRA-4521 completion on 2024-01-15). The flag's fallthrough variation is index 1 (false) and the off variation is also index 1 (false). The flag prerequisite requires `warehouse-migration-active` flag to be ON, which was archived and returns its off-variation (false) in staging. SDK is initialized with `platform-staging` project key. Note: `legacy_yaml_import` flag evaluation follows identical prerequisite chain dependency on `warehouse-migration-active`.

config.network: ALB with TLS termination, no WAF attached
